v5.note: English simple-row smoke fixtures only. Vietnamese and real InBody layouts are not evaluated.

v6.note: PP-OCRv6 medium + spatial field association. Primary research candidate, not released for real health use. V5 baseline is retained separately.

notes: Generic mode uses OCR boxes and known label anchors, never annotation ground truth.
Unlabeled multiple candidate values remain unresolved.
No real-device template is registered yet. Add normalized label_box/value_box only after verifying a permitted sample.
Templates must be explicitly selected with --template; no automatic or oracle routing in the primary pipeline.

design: Each model infers once per input; both associations consume identical tokens. No template/annotation routing.
limitations: Original synthetic regression fixtures, already inspectable; not an untouched real-world test set
CER/WER are computed on raw full-page OCR, not canonical field lines
OCR scores are not calibrated field correctness probabilities
No human correction-rate study, real InBody report, external layout or phone-capture benchmark
CPU timings exclude startup and model downloads
